messages:
Finn (Design): quick idea — add a tiny search + grouping to the legend for long dashboards + a compact 'density' mode for sparklines. mocked it.
Yara (Eng-Frontend): search is great for big metric sets. grouping could be by unit or by tag. density mode would swap line charts for tiny area sparklines to reduce vertical noise.
Cole (DataViz): grouping by unit helps unit harmonization across rows. density mode: use median smoothing for tiny sparklines to avoid misleading jaggedness. show raw-on-hover.
Mei (PM): product win: easier to find metrics and reduce visual clutter. default collapsed groups for teams with >10 series. expose persistent preference per-dashboard.
A11yBot: reminder: search input needs aria-label and clear button; group toggle must be keyboard operable and announce group collapse/expand via aria-live. Ticket #909.
Finn (Design): UX: legend header has search icon then group dropdown (Unit | Tag | None). each group shows a compact header with toggle to expand. density mode toggle in chart header: On/Off with tooltip "Compress visuals for overview; hover to reveal raw lines."
Yara (Eng-Frontend): implementation note: sparse rendering for density mode (canvas) to keep perf. search results should highlight matches in-line and focus first matching series on Enter. keyboard nav: up/down through results, Space toggles visibility. focus ring required.
Cole (DataViz): clipping & units: when grouping by unit we should harmonize y-axis per-group, not per-row, to avoid cross-group mismatch. also compute clipped_count per-series and show small "x clipped" suffix inside group header.
Mei (PM): copy for density tooltip: "Density mode shows compressed sparklines for fast scanning. Toggle to view full chart." clipping microcopy: "Values above display range are clipped for readability. Click to expand."
A11yBot: also ensure sparklines have meaningful text alternatives (aria-describedby) like "median trend up, 3 clipped". keyboard users need a way to open the full chart from the sparkline.
Finn (Design): initial plan: wire up UI mocks + accessibility docs. rollout behind feature flag with analytics: search usage, group toggles, density toggles, and clipped counts.
Yara (Eng-Frontend): i'll add storybook variants and a feature flag. will add endpoints: /legend/meta returning unit groups + clipped counts to avoid extra compute on chart render.
Cole (DataViz): i'll prototype median smoothing strength and provide recommended defaults for density mode.
Mei (PM): schedule: alpha for internal users next week, a11y review before public beta.
Finn (Design): thanks! i'll post updated mocks and keyboard flows here. :sparkles:
